description: Chinese late payment surcharge (滞纳金) of 0.05% per day from the day after the deadline (Tax Collection Law art. 32), with fine ranges: late filing up to 2,000 or 2,000-10,000 CNY (art. 62), tax evasion or unpaid tax 50%-5x (art. 63, 64), and the first-violation no-penalty lists (STA 2021 No. 6 and No. 33). Mainland China, as of 2026-11-21 (laws and State Taxation Administration announcements in the official regulations database). General information and estimates only; no individual tax consulting, agency or filing. The 2027 filing calendar is not yet published.
